notes.title: Bad Caterpillar v2.0
notes.content:
We just released a large update to Bad Caterpillar to add some new cool features you've been asking for and to clean up a few items we felt needed improvement. Full list below... 

[list]
[*] Animated level blocks. 
[*] Some level blocks will carry over between levels.
[*] Updated select player cards.
[*] New player quotes.
[*] Mouse controls work in menus.
[*] Improved randomness of item drops. 
[*] Add option to speed up level complete recaps.
[*] Add support for Steam stats to track things like games played and which characters players use most. 
[*] Resolved a bug where points were not added for killed enemies.
[*] Resolved a bug with object pooling that could lead to late game slowdown.
[/list]

tags.feature: Animated level blocks.

New player quotes.
Mouse controls work in menus.
Add option to speed up level complete recaps.
Add support for Steam stats to track things like games played and which characters players use most.

Resolved a bug with object pooling that could lead to late game slowdown.

notes.title: Bad Caterpillar v1.5
notes.content:
We released a small update to Bad Caterpillar yesterday to address an annoying bug that hangs the game when you exit and a few other minor tweaks. 

[list]
[*] Fix bug where game continues to run in the background after exiting. 
[*] Wider player shots.
[*] Toggle full screen without having to restart the game. 
[*] Music file size reduction.
[*] Updated to newer version of MonoGame framework.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fix bug where game continues to run in the background after exiting.

[*] Music file size reduction.
[*] Updated to newer version of MonoGame framework.

notes.title: CRT Mode in latest update
notes.content:
We just uploaded an update that adds a "CRT Mode" option under the Options screen. This gives Bad Caterpillar the look of playing it on a classic arcade / console. 

I think you guys and gals will enjoy it. And if there are other things you'd like to see us add, please let us know in the comments! 

- Kris

notes.title: Bad Caterpillar 1.2
notes.content:
Released a small update to Bad Caterpillar today...

- Options can now be accessed from the in-game pause menu.
- Fixed a bug with scorpions hitting blocks multiple times or going through blocks instead of turning around. 
- Added some left click / right click mouse menu navigation. Not full menu navigation, but you can cancel out of menus with a right click now and some spots (like the title screen and high scores list) have left button click features. 

Thanks as always for playing the game and let me know any feedback that you have! Thanks,

Kris

notes.title: Bad Caterpillar 1.1
notes.content:
Just letting everyone know we released an update to Bad Caterpillar early yesterday that added several new options to the menu screen based on user feedback received so far. 

1. Option to turn off side art.
2. Option to set sensitivity on mouse.
3. Option to set sensitivity on rumble effects.
4. Don't display cursor during Windowed games and keep cursor centered. 

I'm really encourages by the reception to Bad Caterpillar so far and please keep the feedback coming if there are things you want or things you find that don't work right. 

Thanks everyone!

Kris

2. Option to set sensitivity on mouse.
3. Option to set sensitivity on rumble effects.
4. Don't display cursor during Windowed games and keep cursor centered.
